producer_role: Independent pre-execution evidence producer; not imported by formal runner at execution, but trusted as an authorization-readiness dependency
registry_role: Versioned-schema, append-only mutable runtime invocation audit log; not an immutable member file

option_a.producer: New versioned r11 producer replaces one r10 wrapper row in the 20-member r11 manifest
option_a.registry: Independent append-only runtime state; schema/locator and validation code covered by frozen producer and consumer
option_a.strength: The same r11 member-hash root of trust protects the evidence producer and formal consumer; preflight startup and formal handoff can both verify exact producer bytes.
option_a.required_guard: Frozen consumer verifies producer member SHA, artifact producer SHA, exact claim/prefix and all existing identity/safety fields before adapter execution.
option_a.limitation: This is local integrity/lineage evidence, not cryptographic attestation that a process with no filesystem write access other than the producer created the artifact.
option_a.member_accounting: 14 unchanged + 3 changed existing (scanner, resolver, consumer) + 3 replacement paths (builder, pointer, producer) = 20

option_b.producer: Outside 20 members, but immutable independent path/version/raw SHA pin required
option_b.registry: Independent append-only runtime state with same uniqueness and prefix checks
option_b.strength: Can version producer separately without replacing a member row.
option_b.required_guard: Future authorization binds producer path/SHA/contract version; producer self-checks those pins before claim; frozen consumer verifies code bytes and artifact/registry evidence against the same pins.
option_b.missing_today: No current issuer or frozen consumer enforces this separate producer pin; artifact self-reported script SHA alone is insufficient.
option_b.risk: Second trust root and independent rotation lifecycle could drift from r11 freeze/authorization if any binding is omitted.

registry_fixed_elements: repository-relative locator or frozen resolver rule
allowed claim fields and ID grammar
open_contracts: Exact future r11 authorization issuer and its producer binding fields
Exact r11 registry genesis/claim serialization and path
Formal consumer provenance-check API and locking/prefix rule
Whether local filesystem threat model needs stronger signed producer attestation
